svg.title: Player badge, exploded view
svg.desc: Exploded isometric drawing of the planned badge, top to bottom: front shell with two button holes, button caps (the LIE cap in red), an ESP32-C3 SuperMini on perfboard with two tactile switches, a 450 mAh LiPo, a coin vibration motor with a TP4056 charger, and the back shell. Hardware not built yet.
svg.text: TRUE left, LIE right; red cap marks the lie
battery life still to be measured
